messages:
Evan: Quick ask — can someone run a throughput + p99 latency regression for Runway-3B on the nvlink pool? We saw a wobble on the last canary. Need numbers for seq=2048 and seq=8192 across the usual batch configs. If you can include the exact batch config, tiling, and kv-cache settings that would help (will use for the rollout doc).

Marie: On it. Kicking off microprofiling job now. Plan: seq=2048 and 8192, batch=auto then manual 4/8/16, tiling=on, kv_eviction=off for baseline. ETA ~25m.

Sam: Quick 2048 run finished (nvlink pool, 4 workers, batch=auto):
```bash
bench-run --model runway-3b --seq 2048 --batch auto --tiling on --kv-evict off --workers 4
# -> throughput=420 tok/s, p50=45ms, p99=220ms, errors=0
```
8k baseline (same config): throughput=230 tok/s, p50=110ms, p99=480ms. Attaching raw samples to the artifacts bucket (s3://redwood-artifacts/runway3b/3111112222/).

Evan: Nice. Can you try kv_eviction=on and also toggle tiling=off for the 8192 run? I suspect KV cache thrash is causing the p99 spike.

Sam: Ran kv_eviction=on (tiling=on): 8192 -> throughput=260 tok/s, p50=95ms, p99=420ms. Then tiling=off (kv_eviction=on): 8192 -> throughput=200 tok/s, p50=100ms, p99=390ms. Noise looks a bit high — I'm going to repeat 3x and average.

Ria: Posted profiler snapshot (flame + mem): https://profiler.internal/redwood/runway3b/3111112222 (perm: eng-runtime). Hotspots look like KV lookup spikes around token 6k-7k on long seqs.

Marie: I'll run manual batch-sweep now (4, 8, 16) for seq=8192 with kv_eviction=on and tiling=on to find the knee. Will collate into a short table and drop into the onboarding doc.

Evan: If the batch sweep shows a >10% throughput improvement without regression in p99, we can push a canary with rollback flag. @oncall-bot can you schedule a canary job but keep it pending until we give the green?

oncall-bot: Canary job created (id: runway-3b-canary-3111), scheduled window: 2026-03-18T16:00Z — status: pending. Use `/canary start runway-3b-canary-3111` to run.

Sam: Action items for me: 1) repeat 3x each config and average; 2) enqueue 1hr soak for final chosen config (seq=8192, kv_eviction=on, tiling=on) once Marie posts sweep; 3) upload perf traces to artifacts. Queued the 1hr soak (waiting on manual start).

Ria: Also adding a small eval prompt set to the onboarding checklist to confirm no quality regressions at the long-context tails. I'll add it to the doc and ping @Evan when ready.

Marie: Sweep done — preliminary table: seq=8192, kv_eviction=on, tiling=on, batch=8 gives best p99/throughput tradeoff: avg throughput=275 tok/s, p99=405ms. Dropping the doc into the onboarding folder: s3://redwood-artifacts/runway3b/onboard-summary-3111112222.pdf

Evan: Excellent. Let's greenlight the canary after Sam's final soak completes and Ria's evals pass. Thanks all — this is enough to write the rollout blurb.

Sam: Will report back with soak metrics (expected ~1h).

Ria: Noted — will post eval pass/fail within 30m.

Evan: Closing loop later today, tagging this thread for the release notes.
